'''Pekin''' are a type of [[chicken]] found in the [[Wushanko Isles]]. A group of them can be found on [[Waiko]], to the south of the market. They can also be hatched from eggs on the [[Uncharted Isles]] when a hatch egg contract is obtained from [[Sojobo]]. They periodically lay [[Egg (The Arc)|eggs]]. They also have an [[Undead pekin|undead counterpart]] found on [[Goshima]].
